name: button
purpose: The labelled control that triggers an action. `variant` ranks the action in its view (one `primary`, the rest `secondary`, `outline`, `ghost`, `danger` for a destructive one, or `link` for an action that reads as a link), `size` fits it to its context, and `loading` and `disabled` cover the states in between. With `href` it renders an anchor that looks the same, so a call to action that navigates needs no second component.
useWhen: Use Button `variant="link"` when the text runs an action (no navigation) but should read like a link.
Trigger an action that needs a visible text label: in a form, dialog footer, toolbar or page header.
Mark the main action of a view with `variant="primary"` and the lesser ones with `secondary`, `outline` or `ghost`.
Submit or reset a form with `type="submit"` / `type="reset"`.
A call to action that navigates: set `href` (and `target`) and it renders as an anchor with the same look.

An action that reads as a link — inline in a table cell or a summary (`Connect Git Repository`, `3 rules`, `Resources pending deletion`) — and opens a drawer, a picker or a flow instead of a URL: `variant="link"`. It is still a `<button>`, so keyboard and screen readers get an action.
avoidWhen: One default action with related alternatives in an attached menu → use `split-button`.
A standalone navigation link with a trailing icon and a ghost hover → use `link`.
Link-looking text that goes to a URL in a table cell → `Table.CellLink`; a `variant="link"` Button is for an action with no destination.
The single AI or highlight entry point that must stand out from every other action → use `button-highlight`.
related: icon-button` — icon-only counterpart with the same sizes and a required `ariaLabel`; its `ghost` variant matches this one.
split-button` — joins a Button to a chevron menu of related actions.
button-highlight` — the same prop surface without `variant`, drawn with the brand gradient and a rotating glow rim.
link` — a text link that navigates to a page, resource or URL.
toggle-group` — a group of mutually exclusive options, not a single action.
bestPractices: Keep one `variant="primary"` per view or region; use `danger` only for destructive actions.

variant="link"` has no box: no height, padding or surface, `text-body-sm` in the link colour, underlined on hover. `size` does not apply to it; place it where body text sits (a cell, a summary line, under a section).
Set `loading` while the action resolves: it swaps the icon for a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and suppresses `click`, so the handler needs no extra guard.
Use `iconPosition="leading"` for a glyph that names the action and `"trailing"` for one that points where it goes; add `animated` only on marketing CTAs with a trailing icon.
Put brand or product marks in the `leading` slot; `icon` takes an Azion icon class.
label` is required and is the accessible name; never pass an empty string to get an icon-only control.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text, the fallback of the default slot (pass one or the other). Use `IconButton` for icon-only controls.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual variant. `link` draws an inline text action in the link colour, with no box.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height, padding, and typography.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows loading state and disables activation.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Azion icon class for the icon drawn beside the label.

props.name: iconPosition
props.doc: Which side of the label the icon sits on. `leading` is a glyph that names the action; `trailing` is a glyph that points at where it goes.

props.name: animated
props.doc: Nudges a trailing icon along its axis on hover. Off by default; marketing CTAs opt in.

props.name: href
props.doc: When set, renders as a link (`<a>`).

props.name: type
props.doc: Native button type. `submit` lets the control submit its form; `disabled` and `loading` still block it. Ignored when `href` is set.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The visible label, as shadcn and Radix take children; falls back to `label`. Plain text keeps the button's typography.

slots.name: leading
slots.notes: A mark drawn before the label, ahead of a leading `icon`. It stays first when `iconPosition="trailing"`, so a brand mark and a trailing chevron can share one control.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
</script>

<template>
  <Button
    variant="primary"
    size="large"
    label="Button"
  />
</template>
